services.name: SUP Pilates with Tamra
services.desc: A paddleboard Pilates class combines the core-strengthening exercises of Pilates with the balance challenge of stand-up paddleboarding. The class starts with a brief introduction on land before moving onto the water. This unique workout not only enhances core strength and balance but also offers a serene, mindful experience surrounded by nature. Suitable for all skill levels, some paddleboard experience helpful. 🌊🧘‍♀️ $40 includes use of our yoga boards. $20 BYO board. ![Description of SUP Pilates With Tamra

services.name: DIG Luau at Quail Creek
services.desc: We are excited to partner with our friends from Siva Pasefika to offer you a unique outdoor experience on the water's edge at Quail Lake. Bring your own beach chairs and beach blankets. $55 includes dinner and entertainment. Child tickets (12 and under) are $35. For tickets purchased the day of the event, dinner is not guaranteed. The meal consists of: Chicken or Pork, white rice, mac salad, green salad, cake, and a drink. There are no special meals for dietary restrictions. Feel free to purchase a ticket without a meal and bring your own food if you have a special diet. Reduced park entrance Enjoy the beauty of the islands right here at Quail Lake

services.name: 2 Hour Guided Paddleboard/Kayak Eco Tour
services.desc: Explore sandstone cliffs, limestone coves, jagged shales, and turquoise swimming spots at Quail Creek State Park! Description: Your expert guide will lead you around a beautiful desert lake, at a pace that is comfortable for you, while pointing out wildlife, geology, a couple of great cliff-jumping spots, and shoot video and photos for you, so you can focus on connecting, decompressing, and engaging with this beautiful environment. Our 2-hour tour is long enough for you to enjoy the water, yet short enough that you comfortably can fit other activities into your visit to St. George and Paddle a kayak or a stand up paddleboard with our Certified Guides!
